A hero, huh? I'm not entirely[XENO:n ]
reassured, but very well.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk, are these Telethia as strong as they sound?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]They're quick as lightning and can read your mind.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]A mind-reading giant bird. No problem.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I can see their movement through the Monado, but even[XENO:n ]
that's not enough to get the better of them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]And we're going up against the daddy version.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]No one blink for a second.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]Eyes wide open![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT21 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And don't forget that Melia is our only chance of making it to[XENO:n ]
Eryth Sea. If anything happens to our guide, it's on our heads.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]The Telethia is our target, but don't forget[XENO:n ]
about the person standing next to you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Dunban's right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I am in your debt.[XENO:n ]
My weaknesses are all too apparent.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]No worries, Melia![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I've told Riki all the details about[XENO:n ]
the Dinobeast Telethia-ja-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Now then, Hom Hom, we're counting on you-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Listen carefully, companions-mo. The Dinobeast[XENO:n ]
is incredibly strong-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ]
Good preparation and good equipment for Riki are important-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You want us to get equipment for you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]Exactly-mo. You're[XENO:n ]
smart-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT15 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]When you're ready, come to[XENO:n ]
Riki-mo. We'll leave after that-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]He has some nerve.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

And all he told us about Telethia was,[XENO:n ]
'It's incredibly strong-mo!'[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Is it just me or did we suddenly[XENO:n ]
become Nopon mercenaries?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
